description: Land Acquisition - Kirillawala, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific lands being acquired (including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents), specifies the public purpose for acquisition, and includes procedural requirements for interested parties. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
